heritageTag: Where Heritage Woodwork Meets Digital Precision
heritageTitle: Bridging traditional woodworking mastery with modern computer-guided routing.
heritageDescription: Unlike mass furniture manufacturing, TimberCraft operates as a hybrid architectural studio and digital mill. We specialize in complex 3D wood relief, geometric lattice work, ceiling domes, and decorative paneling. Whether selecting from our curated ready-made catalog or commissioning custom bespoke woodwork for a luxury interior, every piece is milled from sustainably sourced hardwood and hand-finished by master carpenters.

aboutTitle: Master Woodworking Reimagined for the Digital Era.
aboutDescriptionOne: TimberCraft was founded on a simple premise: traditional wood carving possesses an irreplaceable organic warmth, but modern architectural projects demand mathematical precision and rapid scalability.
aboutDescriptionTwo: By pairing master cabinetmakers with senior CNC programmers, we operate a specialized mill capable of 5-axis relief carving, deep 3D routing, and micro-tolerance joinery across premium hardwoods.
